mistake: `df.groupby("Department", "Experience_Years")`: two strings instead of one list

card.title: Group columns passed as separate arguments
card.body: The second positional argument of groupby() is axis, so "Experience_Years" is not read as a grouping key and pandas raises ValueError. Wrap both names in one list: ["Department", "Experience_Years"].
card.guidingQuestion: How does groupby() know that two strings form one set of keys rather than two different arguments?
